    Corners that survive a quotient #

    Let x, y ∈ T' and suppose every point on a path from x to y lies in T'. Then e_y a e_x lies in the ideal generated by the idempotents outside T' only if it is zero (corner_outIdeal'), so a nonzero corner e_y a e_x stays nonzero in A / ⟨e_v : v ∉ T'⟩ (qmap_corner_ne'). This is qmap_corner_ne with convexity required only between x and y.

    theorem LargeIndecomposable.AR.DirData.qmap_corner_ne' {k A : Type u} [Field k] [Ring A] [Algebra k A] (D : DirData k A) {T' : Set D.ι} {x y : D.ι} (hx : x ∈ T') (hy : y ∈ T') (hmid : ∀ (v : D.ι), Relation.ReflTransGen D.Arr x v → Relation.ReflTransGen D.Arr v y → v ∈ T') {a : A} (ha : D.e y * a * D.e x ≠ 0) :
    (D.qmap T') (D.e y * a * D.e x) ≠ 0

    A corner whose interval lies in T' survives in the quotient.
